title: Cocycle-level canonical open-to-open restriction
statement: For a normalized resolution-section comparison c, nested opens A ≤ B, degree q, and a q-cycle z in the section complex over B, c.openEquiv A q applied to the homology class of the cyclesMap of z equals openCohomologyRestriction h G q applied to c.openEquiv B q of the homology class of z.

proof.text: Expand c.open_cocycle at A and B. Rewrite the restricted Ext class with InjectiveResolution.mk₀_comp_extMk, then use etaleOpenFreeSheafUnit_coherence and exact inverse-image composition comparison to identify the resulting Ext morphisms. This proves the equality for the given cycle z.

lean.statement:
theorem resolutionSection_canonical_open_to_open_cycle {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (I : InjectiveResolution G) (c : ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison G I)
    (A B : X.Opens) (h : A ≤ B) (q : ℕ)
    (z : (((etaleSectionFunctor (Scheme.Etale.mk B.ι)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex).cycles q) :
    let K := (((etaleSectionFunctor (Scheme.Etale.mk A.ι)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)
    let L := (((etaleSectionFunctor (Scheme.Etale.mk B.ι)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)
    let φ := etaleSectionMap
      (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (X.homOfLE h) (X.homOfLE_ι _) :
        Scheme.Etale.mk A.ι ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk B.ι) I.cocomplex
    c.openEquiv A q (K.homologyπ q ((HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap φ q) z)) =
      openCohomologyRestriction h G q (c.openEquiv B q (L.homologyπ q z))
